login.title: Sign in
login.checkEmail: Check your email for a sign-in link.
login.error: Sign-in failed. Try again or use another method.
login.accountNotLinked: This email is linked to another sign-in method. Use that method.
login.noProviders: No sign-in method is configured. Ask the instance admin.

cliLogin.title: Authorize the askcalls CLI
cliLogin.intro: The askcalls agent on your computer is asking for a personal access token for this account.
cliLogin.scopes: The token can list, add and change your encrypted calls, use Ask, and fetch your wrapped keys (scopes: read, write, ask, keys). The agent still has to be linked in Settings → Devices before it can decrypt anything.
cliLogin.port: The token goes to the askcalls program listening on this computer at 127.0.0.1:{port}. Continue only if you just ran askcalls login.
cliLogin.sending: Sending the token to askcalls on this computer…
cliLogin.invalid: This sign-in link is not valid. Run askcalls login again.
cliLogin.forbidden: This request did not come from this AskCalls page. Run askcalls login again.
cliLogin.quota: You have reached the limit of personal access tokens. Revoke one in Settings → API and MCP, then run askcalls login again.
cliLogin.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in and run askcalls login again.
cliLogin.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a few minutes, then run askcalls login again.
